name: Sky Clock
summary: A weather card whose sky follows the clock: drag through the day and watch sun, clouds and city lights change
about: A weather card for four Pakistani cities with a sky drawn in SVG. Drag the time bar and the sky shifts from night to dawn to noon to dusk, the sun and moon travel their arcs, clouds drift in three layers and windows light up after sunset. Each city has its own skyline and weather: haze over Lahore, a sea breeze in Karachi, thunder showers in Islamabad and snow over the peaks at Skardu, with the temperature rolling like an odometer.
how: Pick a city at the top: the old skyline sinks, the new one springs up and the reading rolls to its new value.
Drag the time bar (or use the arrow keys on it) to move through the day.
Tap an hourly chip to glide the sun or moon to that hour.
Watch the weather change by the hour: rain and lightning, snow, haze or clear skies.
Press Back to now to return to the current time in Pakistan.
